PC:
Responsiveness: Instructions:  Asks patient to speak or pats patient to elicit verbal response.

i) Not done (0 points)

ii)  Done but not the first critical action completed (0.5 point)

iii) Done before anything else (1 point)

Pulse: Instructions: Checks carotid pulse *prior* to starting chest compressions.

i) Not done (0 points)

ii) Done (1 point)

Chest compressions: Instructions: Compressions must be done with the heel of one hand placed directly on top of the lower half of the sternum and the other hand on top of the first. **Select all that apply:**

i) The depth of compression should be at least 2 inches (5cm) for adults (must hear “click” on mannequin for at least 20 out of 30 compressions) (0.33 points)

ii) At least one set of compressions done with 30  +/- 1 compressions (0.33 points)

iii) The rate of at least 100 compressions per minute (30 compressions in 18 seconds, recommended

by AHA, or about 25 compressions in 15 seconds) (0.33 points)

Airway maneuver:

i) Not done (0 points)

ii) Head tilt/ chin lift maneuver done first (One hand is placed on the forehead while the other hand is placed on the chin, lifting the chin and tilting the head backward.) (0.5 points)

iii) Jaw thrust maneuver done first (the lower jaw is lifted upwards without moving the neck) done (1 point)

Artificial ventilations: Instructions: Provides mouth- to- mouth ventilation by creating a seal over patient's mouth with own mouth and occluding patient’s nostrils. **Select all that apply:**

i) Not done (0 points)

ii) Done but incorrect number of breaths given (0.5 points)

iii) Delivers exactly 2 breaths for at least one cycle of chest compressions (1 point)

Follows up: **Select all that apply:**

i) Continues chest compressions after they are initiated until EMS arrival without any > 10 second delay, except while speaking to EMS (0.33 points)

ii) Continues ventilations until EMS arrival (0.33 points)

iii) Checks pulse after every 5 cycles of ventilations and/or chest compressions (0.33 points)

Prompts: **Select all that apply:**

i) Pulse prompt not required in item 3 (0.33 points)

ii) Chest compression prompt not required in item 4 (0.33 points)

iii) Prompt not required for ventilation in item 7 (0.33 points)
SBP:
EMS: Instructions: Called or directed bystander to call EMS/911.

i) Not done (0 points)

ii) Done (1 point)

AED: Instructions: Directs bystander to bring AED.

i) Not done (0 points)

ii) Done (1 point)
ICS:
EMS Conversation: Instructions: Gives EMS the following information about the patient: **Select all that apply:**

i) Location (0.33 points)

ii) She had been having chest pain (0.33 points)

iii) CPR is in progress (0.33 points)
